<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>BJP electoral dominance:</strong> The BJP has strengthened its legislative position by winning eight of the 10 Uttar Pradesh Rajya Sabha seats unopposed and securing a decisive victory in the Nagaon Lok Sabha bypoll.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Opposition challenges election integrity:</strong> The INDIA bloc has formally raised &quot;vote theft&quot; allegations with President Droupadi Murmu, sparking a political standoff as the BJP dismisses the claims as politically motivated.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a></span></li>
</ul>
